name: Ama
role: Silas's mother — the cairn-line house on Cairnhold's centre lane, and the keeper of a stopped work
knowledge: ⚑ The Waymarker holds a SECOND UNFINISHED LAYER — her husband stopped the work deliberately and left room in it
Why he stopped, which she has never been asked in the right way
Cairnhold's ward-marks, and which are load-bearing
wants: Silas WHOLE AND WELL — not powerful, not a hero. She watches him for cost, not achievement
The father's choice understood rather than mourned
fears: ⛔ That Silas reads his father's stopping as failure. ⚠️ And that he becomes the kind of man who cannot stop.
appearance: A woman who finishes what she is doing before she turns. Flour on both hands. A face that knows the difference between surprise and recognition — and this is the second one.
voiceHints: Quiet, level, and immovable. She corrects without raising anything, and does not repeat herself.

abilities.why: ⚑ the cairn-line house. A place that holds because she keeps it
she has kept one for years and nobody asked her to

physicality: ADULT. Sixties, sturdy, flour to the wrist, grey worn back plainly. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she finishes what she is doing before she turns, every time, and it is not slowness — it is that nothing has hurried her since the day her husband stopped.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ SHE IS SILAS'S MOTHER AND `romanceEligible: false` REFLECTS THAT — an author decision per R24. ⚠️ THIS ENTRY EXISTS BECAUSE A GM STILL NEEDS TO DESCRIBE HER: at the table, at the cairn-line, standing in a doorway deciding whether to say the thing. ⚑ TOUCH IS A HAND ON A FOREARM AND A PLATE PUT DOWN IN FRONT OF YOU. ⛔ AND THE THING SHE WILL NOT DISCUSS UNBIDDEN IS WHY HE STOPPED — she has never been asked in the right way, and a GM should let that stay closed until it is.
_authoredWhy: ⛔ AUTHORED 2026-09-05 — PROMOTED FROM THE REGISTRY, NOT INVENTED. This person existed only as a GENERATED registry entry with `skillsObserved`; R28: 'generated is promotable to authored.' ⚑ THE CRAFTS ARE DRAWN FROM WHAT THE STORY ALREADY SHOWED — `skillsObserved` is `growthFor`'s own evidence field, and Pell's 'ironsense' turned out to be three crafts when it was read properly. ⚠️ `domains` is `{primary, secondary, tertiary}` — an ARRAY returns band 'open' and lets `kitFor` draw from the whole catalogue. ⛔ Nothing here reaches across the circle.
_personalityWhy: ⛔ `personality` IS FOUR NUMERIC DIALS — `warmth · trust · candor · patience`, roughly -1..1 in the schema's words and 0-10 in practice (Pell: 6/7/9/5). ⚠️ AEVI AUTHORED IT AS PROSE ON ALL FOUR SHEETS ('warmth: high, unsentimental') and the schema caught two of them. ✅ THAT IS THE SCHEMA DOING THE JOB IT COULD NOT DO YESTERDAY — before today's +22 it declared 25 properties and would have passed all four.
_idFix_20260905: ⛔ ID DID NOT RESOLVE AGAINST THE LIVE SAVE. CCode's quest fix surfaced this class: 'the save says `the-mercy-that-wont-ask`; the def says `the_mercy_that_wont_ask` — matching raw finds nothing.' ⚠️ THE SAME SPLIT WAS LIVE IN THE NPC REGISTRY, from Aevi's own authoring pass hours earlier. ✅ Fixed at the CONTENT end, because the registry key is written by PLAY and the authored file is the thing that can move. ⛔ A promoted NPC whose id does not match the registry entry it was promoted FROM is an authored record the game can never find. ⚑ HERE: the registry key written by play is `silas-mother` — Aevi gave the file the id `ama`, which is her NAME, and nothing in the save could ever match it.
questSeeds: ⛑ The Waymarker holds a SECOND UNFINISHED LAYER. Her husband stopped the work deliberately and left room in it. She has never been asked why in the right way — and the right way is asking about HIM rather than about the stone.
Cairnhold's ward-marks are failing in an order she recognises and nobody else has noticed. She will not raise it; she will mention it while doing something else.
_questSeedsWhy: ⛔ SNG-167 §2. 'A LOCATION can start an arc and a PERSON cannot — rule 10 weaves the location's questSeeds and there is no equivalent for anyone you meet. THAT IS BACKWARDS: THE MEMORABLE ARCS START WITH SOMEONE, NOT SOMEWHERE.' ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-06: ZERO of 48 NPCs carried a seed and every one fell back to the derived want — and the ratchet went red at 48 because Aevi authored a 48th person without one. ⚑ A SEED IS AN ERRAND THE PERSON WOULD ACTUALLY ASK FOR, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears` — not a hook the world hands them. ⛔ R49's shape: a seed that names no objective is a nebulous hook one layer down.
